No winner, loser or individual performance can be declared from the supplied results. The scoreboard has essentially called timeout before the opening snap.

Why They Rank Here

  • 1. Kirkumcised Penix: CeeDee Lamb, James Cook, Derrick Henry and Jayden Daniels headline an elite, balanced starting lineup with strong quarterback, running back and tight end depth.
  • 2. alexvandeusen: Christian McCaffrey, De'Von Achane, Breece Hall, Nico Collins and Brock Bowers create exceptional upside, supported by outstanding quarterback and tight end depth.
  • 3. arupert12: Justin Jefferson, Jonathan Taylor, Jalen Hurts, Tee Higgins and Chris Olave provide premium talent and excellent balance across every major starting position.
  • 4. OguguaAnunoby: Jahmyr Gibbs leads a deep backfield alongside Josh Jacobs and Kenneth Walker, while Drake London anchors a talented receiving group.
  • 5. Al-Qaeda Crashouts: Amon-Ra St. Brown, A.J. Brown and Trey McBride form an elite receiving core, complemented by Kyren Williams and Bucky Irving.
  • 6. 4Anthony2: Josh Allen, Bijan Robinson and Omarion Hampton offer a powerful foundation, though the starting receiving group carries more uncertainty than the top contenders.
  • 7. shmeems: Lamar Jackson, Puka Nacua, Rashee Rice and Sam LaPorta supply elite upside, but the running back group relies heavily on younger, less-established options.
  • 8. Muth Juice: Ja'Marr Chase leads a strong receiving corps with Ladd McConkey and George Pickens, while Chase Brown provides the backfield anchor.
  • 9. Chef Boyardee: Saquon Barkley, Malik Nabers and Garrett Wilson provide star power, but Trevor Lawrence and an inexperienced supporting backfield lower the overall floor.
  • 10. Secret service chat: Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Ashton Jeanty bring major upside, but the roster has fewer proven premium starters and thinner receiving depth than league leaders.

Fraud Watch

Status: Everybody remains under investigation. No team scored, won or lost in the supplied Week 1 results. Kirkumcised Penix has the No. 1 ranking and the shortest championship odds, but even the league favorite is sitting on the same 0.0 points as the basement. Secret service chat ranks 10th, yet trails nobody in the standings. Until actual separation appears, the entire league is wearing the same suspicious fake mustache.

Stock Up

  • Kirkumcised Penix: The official board’s top team carries a 92 power score and league-best +450 championship odds.
  • alexvandeusen: A 90 power score and +500 odds place this roster directly behind the favorite.
  • arupert12: Third place on the official board, an 87 power score and +625 odds create a strong opening position.

Stock Down

  • Muth Juice: Eighth on the official board with a 75 power score and +1300 odds.
  • Chef Boyardee: Ninth with a 72 power score and +1575 odds. The chef has ingredients, but the official board is not handing out stars yet.
  • Secret service chat: The No. 10 ranking, 69 power score and +1875 odds bring up the rear. At least the 0.0 score is currently good enough to tie every contender.

Weekly Awards

  • Top-of-the-Board Award: Kirkumcised Penix, ranked No. 1 with a 92 power score.
  • Photo Finish Award: All five matchups, each tied by exactly 0.0 points.
  • Participation Trophy of the Week: All 10 teams, each sitting at 0-0 with 0.0 points for and 0.0 points against.
  • Transaction Wire Award: Muth Juice added Keenan Allen, while Kirkumcised Penix added Brock Purdy.
  • Trade Desk Award: Chef Boyardee acquired Trevor Lawrence and Al-Qaeda Crashouts acquired Tyler Bass in a completed trade.
